name: prism-matching-engine
description: Prism Matching Engine is the core of an exchange in plain JavaScript. Orders are validated against tick, lot, price band and available funds, then matched by price-time priority against sorted price levels with FIFO queues. Every fill settles immediately in a double-entry ledger (base, quote and fees, all integer 1e-8 units with BigInt notional), and resting orders hold exactly the funds they can still use. Stops trigger on the last trade and can cascade. A FIX 4.4 session layer handles Logon, sequence gaps, NewOrderSingle, Cancel and Replace with real BodyLength and CheckSum, and a TCP gateway exposes it. Every command is journaled, so replaying the journal on a fresh engine reproduces the same SHA-256 state hash.
author: Soumya Bhandare (krishyaa06)
